qaList.congratulationQuote: Congratulations Tarun and team on very impressive volume delivery and the Rizta ramp-up.
qaList.question: Could you share the order book split between the 450 series and the new Rizta? Are you seeing any cannibalization of your premium 450X customer base in tier-1 cities?
qaList.response: Thank you Kapil. Rizta currently accounts for roughly 55% of our weekly order intake, and the encouraging sign is that 82% of Rizta buyers are first-time Ather owners who previously rode 110cc-125cc ICE commuter scooters. We have observed less than 6% cannibalization on the 450X. The 450 series continues to command strong enthusiast loyalty in Bangalore, Chennai, and Pune, while Rizta is expanding our addressable base across Gujarat, Rajasthan, and northern markets.
qaList.speaker: Tarun Mehta (CEO)
qaList.keyTakeaway: Rizta drives incremental non-metro volume without cannibalizing high-margin 450X.

qaList.congratulationQuote: Heartiest congratulations on reaching gross margin expansion in an environment where peers are bleeding.
qaList.question: How sustainable is the 18.4% gross margin per unit if commodity prices turn or if competitive discounts escalate in the upcoming festive quarter?
qaList.response: Our margin improvement is structural rather than temporary. Over the past four quarters, our engineering team re-architected the wiring harness, consolidated controllers, and transitioned to larger-format cells that lowered packing complexity. Even if we have to offer tactical promotional pricing of ₹3,000–4,000 in certain regions to counter legacy OEM push, our bill-of-materials cost-downs give us sufficient buffer to maintain margins above 17.5%.
qaList.speaker: Sohil Parekh (CFO)
qaList.keyTakeaway: BOM optimization and localized cell integration provide durable gross margin buffer.

qaList.congratulationQuote: Congrats on the strong quarterly execution.
qaList.question: What is the expected timeline for commercial production at the new Maharashtra facility, and what will the cash burn look like over the next two quarters?
qaList.response: The Aurangabad facility phase 1 construction is tracking 3 weeks ahead of schedule. We anticipate trial production commencing in Q1 FY26, bringing 0.5 million units of installed capacity. Between our existing cash reserves and operating cash generation, the entire ₹450 Cr capex program is fully funded without requiring external equity dilution.
qaList.speaker: Tarun Mehta (CEO)
qaList.keyTakeaway: New facility is fully funded from internal cash balances with trial production by Q1 FY26.

qaList.congratulationQuote: Congratulations on the solid set of numbers and market share resilience.
qaList.question: Some market participants raised queries about battery degradation claims and replacement liability. Could you provide clarity on your warranty claims ratio?
qaList.response: Our cumulative warranty claim rate across our entire active fleet on Indian roads stands at 0.38%, which is among the lowest in global two-wheeler EV benchmarks. Our proprietary thermal management algorithm and BMS telematics give us real-time cell health across 250,000+ vehicles on road, and our warranty provisioning is conservative and audited.
qaList.speaker: Swapnil Jain (CTO)
qaList.keyTakeaway: Fleet warranty claim rate is exceptionally low at 0.38%; telematics track battery degradation in real time.

qaList.question: As you expand to 350 touchpoints, are dealers carrying inventory on their books, or is there channel stuffing before the quarter close?
qaList.response: We operate strictly on a pull-based dealership model. Dealer inventory days currently average 16 days, which is less than half of the typical ICE industry benchmark of 35–45 days. We do not engage in end-of-quarter push wholesale billing.
qaList.speaker: Sohil Parekh (CFO)
qaList.keyTakeaway: Channel inventory is tightly controlled at 16 days with zero wholesale stuffing.

qaList.question: What is the monthly active renewal rate for Ather Connect Pro subscription services, and when does software ARR become a material contributor to EBITDA?
qaList.response: Ather Connect subscription renewal after the initial free period has improved from 41% to 64% with the rollout of Live Location Sharing, SmartEco, and theft alerts. While software revenue is currently around ₹42 Cr annualized, it yields a 78% contribution margin and will meaningfully buffer fixed corporate overhead as fleet size scales past 500,000 vehicles.
qaList.speaker: Tarun Mehta (CEO)
qaList.keyTakeaway: Software renewal improved to 64% with high 78% margin; long-term recurring profit driver.

qaList.question: What are your top three strategic focal points over the next 18 to 24 months, and where do you see the next leg of RoA expansion coming from?
qaList.response: Thank you Mahrukh. My top three priorities are: first, scaling our commercial banking franchise where we have historically punched below our weight; second, expanding non-interest fee income via wealth management, forex, and transaction banking; and third, sweating our branch network to improve CASA density outside our home state of Kerala. Through these levers, we aim to transition RoA comfortably from 1.34% toward the 1.45% mark.
